prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Strontium (Sr) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a vast fantasy library of towering shelves, spiral stairs and floating candles
Time of day: warm lamplight or candlelight indoors, the rest in shadow.
Outfit: couture with stiff panels standing slightly away from the body — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing, leaning back against a wall.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the wall.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand tucks hair behind her ear.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — strontium: a soft silvery alkaline-earth metal that yellows in air, named for Strontian, a village in the Scottish Highlands whose lead mines yielded the strange stone strontianite around 1790, its metal freed by electricity in 1808; its salts burn the deepest crimson red of any flame, the red of fireworks and of distress flares at sea; strontium aluminate glow paint drinks in light and gives it back as a soft aqua-green afterglow for hours in the dark; like calcium it settles into bones and seashells — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
